object: Tang-dynasty Shenlong copy of Wang Xizhi’s Orchid Pavilion Preface; traditionally attributed to Feng Chengsu, attribution not secure; not Wang Xizhi’s autograph.
source_rights_statement: Commons labels the source PD-Art/Public Domain Mark. This records the platform statement, not a museum licence.
reading_order: Columns right to left; characters top to bottom. Column numbers count main-text columns only; small side additions do not form separate columns.
visual_cross_check: Checked against official collection image and official Forbidden City 2022 no.12 PDF pages 3–5 (printed 16–18).
limitations: Images show main text only, not complete mounted scroll. Some detail edges retain fragments of neighbouring columns. Crops are not separate source photographs.
